title: Clause 4 - Context of the Organization
description: Working paper template for ISO/IEC 42001 Clause 4: AIMS context, interested parties, scope, and AI roles.

sections.title: External and internal issues (4.1)
prompts: List the auditee's external and internal issues relevant to its purpose and AIMS direction.
Identify which issues materially affect AI risk posture (e.g., regulatory shift, market exit).
Confirm the issues register is reviewed at planned intervals.

sections.title: Interested parties (4.2)
prompts: Enumerate interested parties (regulators, customers, data subjects, downstream users, society at large).
Confirm requirements of each party are documented.
Verify obligations from EU AI Act / sector regulators are captured if applicable.

sections.title: AIMS scope (4.3)
prompts: Quote the boundary of the AIMS (organizational, functional, geographic).
Confirm the scope statement names the AI systems in scope.

sections.title: AI roles, processes, and AIMS (4.4)
prompts: Document the auditee's role for each AI system: provider, deployer, AI subject, etc.
Map AI lifecycle processes and confirm AIMS coverage.

checklists.text: AIMS scope statement is documented and current.
AI role(s) are explicit per system.
Issues register review cadence is defined and respected.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Which AI systems are in your AIMS scope today, and which are deliberately excluded?
How is the interested-party register kept current?
Who decides the AI role classification for each system?
